data.name: Bulls and Cows: The Summoning
data.shortDescription: Summon a demon by guessing its secret sigil. Each try tells you how many symbols are right and in place, and how many are right but misplaced. No attempt limit, but speed counts.

cardImage.alt: A dark summoning ritual with a shadowy demon standing inside a glowing red pentagram, surrounded by darkness and eerie crimson light

data.name: Moosweep
data.shortDescription: You're a gourmet cow on a 9x9 field. Eat all the grass you can, but watch out for the mines. Your sensitive nose tells you how many are nearby.

cardImage.alt: A cute brown-and-white cow standing in a fenced grassy field filled with small plants and yellow flowers

data.name: Minesweeper
data.shortDescription: The classic mine-clearing puzzle. Open cells, read the numbers, flag the suspicious ones and try not to blow up. One wrong click and it's over.

cardImage.alt: A classic minesweeper game with a grid of covered and revealed cells, numbered clues and flags marking suspected mines on a dark background

data.name: RSS CSS Selectors
data.shortDescription: A little trainer for CSS selectors. Some elements on the table pulse, you write a selector that hits exactly those. Stuck? There's a Help button that types the answer for you.

cardImage.alt: A CSS selector learning game featuring cute animals resting on plates, with a colorful title banner and illustrated cats and capybaras

data.name: Pair 'em Up
data.shortDescription: A number-matching puzzle on a 9-column grid. Remove pairs that are equal or add up to 10 and reach 100 points before you run out of moves and helpers.

cardImage.alt: A neon number-matching puzzle with a glowing grid of numbers, two highlighted cells and a dark background

data.name: Forest Guardians
data.shortDescription: A small tactical game about saving a forest from spreading fire. Start with one scout squirrel, find the towns, hire helpers and put the flames out.

cardImage.alt: A forest wildlife scene with a squirrel, turtle and hedgehog near a pond, surrounded by burning trees and a wildfire spreading through the woodland toward a distant castle

data.name: Memory Game: Neither This Nor That
data.shortDescription: A vegetable dark fantasy memory game. Eight princes court a princess, she rejects every pair you find and eats them. The last one left wins her hand.

cardImage.alt: A dark fantasy illustration of a crowned vegetable princess holding a scepter, surrounded by eerie botanical decorations, moon imagery and gothic ornamental artwork

data.name: Virtual Music Kit
data.shortDescription: Play a virtual instrument with your mouse or keyboard. Seven sounds, keys you can rebind, and a sequence field to play whole melodies automatically.

cardImage.alt: A stylized kalimba with colorful wooden tines arranged in a row, ready to be played as a virtual musical instrument

data.name: Pumpkin Patch Days
data.shortDescription: A slow little farm game about growing pumpkins. Plant, water, wait for the weather to behave, and turn your harvest into soups and pies for the village fair.

cardImage.alt: A farmer harvesting a large pumpkin in an autumn field, surrounded by smaller pumpkins, a wooden cart full of produce and golden countryside hills

data.name: Lantern Moth
data.shortDescription: Play as a tiny moth carrying a lantern through a dark forest. Follow the light, wake sleeping fireflies and find the way back to the old oak.

cardImage.alt: A glowing moth carrying a lantern in a dark enchanted forest, surrounded by twisted tree roots, tiny mushrooms and magical lights

data.name: Pocket Bakery
data.shortDescription: Run a tiny bakery out of a single pocket-sized shop. Mix dough, bake bread and decorate cakes for the neighbors before the oven goes cold.

cardImage.alt: A cozy bakery with a smiling baker behind the counter, fresh bread, pastries, cakes, a brick oven and customers enjoying the shop

data.name: Moon Piano
data.shortDescription: A dreamy piano you play under the night sky. Tap the keys to make soft melodies and watch the moon respond to every note.

cardImage.alt: A glowing grand piano in a moonlit landscape, with a large full moon, floating rings, distant mountains and a starry blue sky

data.name: Beehive Valley
data.shortDescription: Look after a valley full of bees. Place hives, plant flowers that bloom in different seasons and collect honey without annoying anyone, including the bees.

cardImage.alt: A beekeeper tending wooden hives in a flower-filled meadow, with rolling green hills, wildflowers, honey jars and a peaceful countryside landscape

data.name: The Last Lighthouse
data.shortDescription: You are the new keeper of a lonely lighthouse. Fix the lamp, answer strange radio messages and guess what the sea wants from you.

cardImage.alt: A lone lighthouse keeper walks along a rocky shoreline toward a glowing lighthouse in a dark, stormy sea

data.name: Tiny Train Depot
data.shortDescription: Build and run a small train depot. Lay tracks, schedule little trains and keep the passengers from missing their connections.

cardImage.alt: A miniature railway station with branching tracks, a steam locomotive, waiting passengers, station buildings and train management controls

data.name: Sleepy Fishing Pond
data.shortDescription: A very chill fishing game. Cast the line, wait, reel in whatever bites and fill the pond journal. Nothing gets away, nothing is rushed.

cardImage.alt: A peaceful fishing scene with a person sitting on a wooden dock over a misty pond at sunrise, holding a fishing rod among reeds and calm water

data.name: Paper Boats
data.shortDescription: Fold little paper boats and send them down a rainy street. Steer them around puddles, leaves and curious ducks.

cardImage.alt: Colorful origami boats floating in rainwater among autumn leaves, with small yellow ducks in the background

data.name: Sock Sorter
data.shortDescription: Find the matching socks in a giant laundry pile. Sort by pattern, color and mood before the washing machine finishes.

cardImage.alt: A cartoon grey animal sits atop a colorful pile of mismatched socks beside a washing machine, with a matching-pairs counter and countdown timer

data.name: Little Orchard
data.shortDescription: Grow a small orchard one tree at a time. Prune, graft and pick fruit, then sell it at the Sunday market or turn it into jam.

cardImage.alt: A gardener picking apples from a small tree in a peaceful orchard, with baskets of fruit, a rustic workbench and jars of preserves

data.name: Mushroom Road
data.shortDescription: A tiny road trip adventure through a mushroom forest. Hitch rides with weird travelers, collect stories and try to reach the festival on time.

cardImage.alt: A whimsical forest path winding through an enchanted woodland filled with giant mushrooms, mushroom houses, glowing plants and a tiny snail traveler

data.name: Rainy Day Bookshop
data.shortDescription: A cozy bookshop where it always seems to be raining. Sort books, recommend the right one to each visitor and rearrange the shelves.

cardImage.alt: A customer browsing a book in a cozy secondhand bookshop while chatting with the shopkeeper across the counter, with warm lamps, bookshelves and a sleeping cat

data.name: Pebble Stack
data.shortDescription: Stack pebbles into tall wobbly towers. Pick the right stone, find the balance point and try not to sneeze.

cardImage.alt: Hands carefully balancing smooth stones into a tall stack above a mossy rock in a shallow stream

data.name: Drum Circle Dash
data.shortDescription: A fast rhythm game with hand drums. Hit the right pad at the right time and keep the circle going as the tempo ramps up.

cardImage.alt: A rhythm game featuring drummers playing glowing hand drums at a lively outdoor festival, with musical notes, lanterns and rhythm-based game modes

data.name: Jelly Jump
data.shortDescription: Bounce a little jelly up a tower of floating platforms. Time your jumps, collect sweets and try not to land on the sour ones.

cardImage.alt: A pink jelly character bouncing between colorful candy-shaped platforms in a bright pastel sky, surrounded by floating sweets
